screen0.intro:
Thank you for visiting
the National Museum of Korea.
I am a researcher at the Graduate School
of Techno Design, Kookmin University.
This short survey is part of my study
to improve the visit experience
for international visitors.
It takes only about 4 minutes
and all responses are completely anonymous
— no personal identifying information is collected.
screen0.consent: I understand and agree to participate
screen0.instruction: Please complete this just before you enter the exhibition halls.

sectionA.title: Section A. About you
sectionA.a1: A1. Which country do you live in?
sectionA.a2: A2. What is your age group?
sectionA.a4: A4. Which language do you mainly use in daily life?

sectionB.title: Section B. Your visit
sectionB.b1: B1. What brings you to Korea?
sectionB.b2: B2. Is this your first visit to the National Museum of Korea?
sectionB.b3: B3. How many people are in your group today (including yourself)?
sectionB.b4: B4. Did you look up information about this museum or its exhibitions before coming?
sectionB.b5: B5. Did you bring a bag or luggage with you today?
b5_options: Only a small bag or handbag

sectionC.title: Section C. Your waiting experience today
sectionC.c1: C1. How did the time you spent waiting to enter feel to you?
sectionC.c2: C2. How did you feel while waiting?
sectionC.c3: C3. Which part felt the most uncomfortable?
c3_options: Walking from the subway station to the museum
The outdoor plaza and stairs in front of the museum
The outdoor queue in front of the building
The long indoor corridor before the exhibition halls
sectionC.c5: C5. How long do you think you actually waited before entering the exhibition halls?
sectionC.c4: C4. While waiting, how much do you agree with each statement?
c4_q: 1. I understood what the line I was standing in was for
2. I knew how much longer I had to wait
3. I knew where I needed to go
4. The waiting time did not feel boring
5. The waiting area was comfortable (heat, crowding, seating)
6. There was something interesting to look at while waiting
7. The waiting area did not feel cramped
8. The surrounding noise did not bother me

sectionD.title: Section D. Your expectations right now
sectionD.d1: D1. You are about to see the exhibition. How much do you agree with each statement?
d1_q: 1. I am looking forward to seeing the exhibition
2. I expect today's visit to be enjoyable
3. I have a clear idea of what I am going to see
sectionD.d2: D2. Did the time you spent waiting affect your expectations for the visit?

sectionE.title: Section E. Information and behaviour while waiting
sectionE.e1: E1. What did you mainly do while waiting?
e1_options: Picked up a leaflet or map at the entrance
It was hard to use my phone because of my bags or belongings
sectionE.e2: E2. If you used your phone, what did you look at?
sectionE.e3: E3. Which language did you use to understand the museum's signage and guides today?
e3_options: I couldn't understand any of the signs/guides
sectionE.e4: E4. Did you have any difficulty getting information at the museum today?
e4_options: Language made it hard to understand
I did not know where to find the information I needed
Signage text was too small or lacked detail

sectionF.title: Section F. What would help
sectionF.f1: F1. Before entering the exhibition halls, what did you most want to know?
sectionF.f1_limit: You can select up to 2 choices.
f1_options: A recommended route through the museum
Facilities such as restrooms and lockers
sectionF.f2: F2. If the following were available on your phone while waiting, would you use them?
f2_options: Introduction to Korean history and culture
I probably would not use any of these
sectionF.f3: F3. Waiting to enter cannot be fully removed because of the number of visitors. Which of the following would help you most?
f3_options: Telling me exactly how long I need to wait
Having something to look at or read while waiting
